catalog.title: Scribble Picture 26
catalog.description_raw: Digital Work, XH2 Fuji, Greenwich village
catalog.caption: Greenwich village

described.alt_text: A photograph of a Greenwich Village corner shop beneath a billboard, where the billboard has been repainted as a cartoon of a hand, a second billboard shows a cartoon suitcase, a yellow cab is redrawn as a cartoon, and small creatures perch on the building, signed 24.
described.description: A portrait format digital piece on a photograph, signed Matt Crump 24 at lower left. A low tan brick corner building with a red framed shop at its base sits beneath a red brick wall. A large billboard on a frame above has been replaced with a cartoon painting of an orange hand reaching into a green and blue abstract with a scribbled slogan. Below it a second white billboard carries a drawing of a rounded white box or case shape with a triangle like a sail beside it. Small creatures perch on the building: a tan one at the top right corner, a white winged one on the wall, a long eared one at right. A traffic light at right is redrawn in flat yellow and pink, a no trucks sign and arrows hang on a drawn lamp post. The shop signs are blanked to cream panels with scribbles. A yellow cab is redrawn as a rounded cartoon car with a horn on its roof at lower left, and three pedestrians with blank faces walk at the crossing on the right. The sky is blue with soft clouds.
described.impression: Advertising replaced by doodles: the hand on the billboard sells nothing and the white billboard shows a suitcase daydream. The cab has a horn, which makes it a creature rather than a car. The whole corner has been gently repurposed as a gallery for the drawing, and the people walk through as if nothing happened.
